r2_body: † Who turneth the ſea into drie land, in the riuer they shal paſſe on foote, there we shal reioyce in him. The read ſea, ſ when Ioſue brought the people ouer Iordan, in remembring and reeiting theſe ſingular benefites. † Who ruleth in his ſtrength for euer his eyes looke vpon the gentiles: they that exaſperate him ler them not be exalted in themſelues. AGods choſen people the ſewes did often exaſperate God by iheir ingratitude, murmuring, and other ſinnes: whom the prophet therfore admoniſheth, not to be proud, leſt they be ſaboued, and broue ht lowe. † Ye Gentiles bleſſe, our God : and make the voice of his prayſe hearde. kA way of inutiation the Pſalmiſt prophecieth ihe conuerſion ef Gentilti. † Who hath put my ſoule in life : and hath not geuen my feete to be moued. I The voice of the whole Church: confeſſing Gods proui lence and protectioa, that ſhe neuer ſa lethꝫ for the Iewes faſſing ſrom Chriſt the Gentiles beleued in hims and ſome nauoes, ot countries failing from Relicion, others are conuerted † Becauſe thou haſt proued vs ô God: by fire thou haſt tried o vs, as ſiluer is tried. God ſuffereth his Church to be perſecuted w. th alkindes of tribularion, as ſome are here † Thou haſt brought vs into a ſnare, thou haſt laide tribule tions on our backe : thou haſt ſet men vpon our heades. † We haue paſſed through fire and water: and thou haſt brought vs out into refreshing. Bur throngh Godi aſſiſtance his ſoruauts paſſe through, and ouercome altentatioas. I wil goe into thy houſe with holocauſtes : I wil render thre my vowes: † which my lippes haue diſtinguished. And my mouth hath ſpoken in my tribulation. Sacrifice of thankes, and voluntatie vowes, that which anie promiſcih to God in tribu- laten, they muſt perſorme accordingly. † Holocauſtes with marrow wil I offer to thee, with incenſe of rammes : I wil offer to thee oxen with bucke goates. Theſe weve the beſt externaſ ſacrificcs of the old law. Come ye, hieare, and I wil tel al ye that feare God, what gpeat things he hath done for my ſoule. But both then and no v the internaſ ſacrifices of contrite hart, of iuſtice, and of diuins praiſe beſt pleaſe God † To him haue I cried with my mouth, and haue exulted : vn- der my tongue. t from ihe hari, ivhich is undei the iongue, auddirecteth the fongue what to Prake. †f I haue beheld iniquitie in my hart, our Lord wil not heare. YVhofoeuer vi be heard in prayer, Fuſ repen: aſ hir ſinaes. † Therfore
